name: rustcx
description: Cyclomatic complexity diagnostics and hover for Rust

rustcx.threshold.markdownDescription: Functions scoring at or above this value are warnings; at or above twice it, errors. Leave `null` to use the `threshold` in `rustcx.toml`, or the built-in default if there is no such file.

rustcx.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `rustcx` executable. Leave blank to resolve from `PATH`, falling back to `~/.cargo/bin/rustcx`.
